# Rajat Ravinder Varuni

> CISO and Senior Director, Operations. Co-designed the cryptography behind Login.gov. AWS shipped two of his published solutions as product features. ISO 27001 certified on the first attempt with zero nonconformities. Based in Aldie, Virginia, Washington DC metro. U.S. citizen.

This site is a single page: the full professional record, with a linked source for every claim. Most of the proof was published by someone other than him.

## Key facts
- Login.gov: partnered with the GSA CISO on a NIST-peer-reviewed two-layer cryptographic scheme. Login.gov's August 2026 roadmap reports 180M+ accounts, 500M+ sign-ins a year, 700+ sites and services, 54 agencies and states.
- 18F: led the TIC 2.0 Overlay pilot with DHS, Sandia National Laboratories, the FedRAMP office and AWS. FedRAMP authorizations followed for Login.gov, cloud.gov and vote.gov.
- AWS: WAF geographic filtering he published was built into the product; GuardDuty threat-intelligence automation adopted into Login.gov operations.
- Audits: ISO 27001:2022 first attempt, zero nonconformities, UKAS accredited; 2024 and 2025 HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD cycles closed "None Noted".
- AI: fifteen-agent security platform in production under audit; ISO/IEC 42001 activated June 2025; AI insider incident contained in four hours.
- Recognition: Vanta 25 to Trust Award (2025); Lacework Modern CISO Network Board Book, third edition, carried in the New York Times; AWS re:Invent 2014 hackathon winner.
- Published: ISAO 300-2 co-author; two SANS whitepapers; three AWS Security Blog guides; technical editor on two McGraw-Hill AWS certification guides; judge, ISACA Global Achievement Awards.
- Built: CertScore and Honor Library, live on the App Store and Google Play; founder of V2C.org, a 501(c)(3); named inventor on a pending U.S. patent.
- Certifications: CISSP, CISM, C|CISO, HITRUST CCSFP, GIAC GPEN, CEH, AWS Certified Security Specialty, Boardroom Certified QTE.
